brief:
An olive press in Gaza has partially returned to operation following damage sustained during the ongoing conflict, Ma'an Wire reported. The facility, which processes olives into oil, faced significant disruption from the war but has managed to resume limited work despite the challenging conditions.

The partial resumption reflects efforts by residents to restore economic activity in Gaza amid widespread destruction. Olive oil production remains a traditional industry in the territory, though the conflict has severely hindered normal agricultural and industrial operations.
title: Gaza olive press partially resumes operations despite war damage
